short_description: Non-canonical FirstPersonEmbodiment prototype layered on the accepted CH9.6 character, clothing, Item Graph and ENet presentation stack.
purpose: Evaluate first-person hands, clothing-visible viewmodels, independent left/right grip UX and network-state projection without reopening or mutating the frozen CH9.6 checkpoint and without claiming item/network authority.
expected_outcome: A separate research lab can render two first-person hands, mirror the server-backed selected hotbar item with immediate local presentation, project upper clothing into first person, exercise local-only grab targets, and fail closed for canonical world-item grabbing until an explicit hand authority contract is authorized.
current_stage: FPE-R1 Fix7 — immediate hotbar presentation, empty-hand clear and network-equipment UI result repair
progress_note: Operator graphical evidence accepts the core Fix6 performance hypothesis: continuous movement and Tab/inventory are now smooth and the previous periodic main-thread hitch is gone after automatic inherited CH6-CH9 diagnostic rebuilds were disabled. Remaining defects are functional rather than performance-related. First, hotbar visual selection still trails input by roughly half a second even though transport is nonblocking. Code review shows the selected index is locally predicted immediately but the hand proxy was only consumed on a later presentation sync. Second, selecting an empty slot leaves the previous item in the hand. Root cause is deterministic: _select_hotbar_nonblocking cleared _last_hotbar_item_id before the sync; an empty selected slot then compared equal to the already-cleared fingerprint and returned without calling clear_authoritative_hand_item. Third, equipment drag can display CHARACTER_EQUIPMENT_NETWORK_APPLY_FAILED even when the server operation succeeded and the authoritative replica already moved the item. The accepted NetworkCharacterEquipmentGameplayController reports a top-level operation failure whenever a synchronous post-network presentation refresh fails, even though ItemGameplayController has already installed the authoritative replica. Fix7 stays additive and research-only. QuaterniusFirstPersonEmbodimentFix7 applies the selected hotbar hand proxy synchronously in the input callback using canonical hotbar contents plus a presentation-only predicted selected index, clears the hand immediately for empty/missing slots, and listens to the Fix6 classified host signal so hotbar-only authority updates do not dirty equipment. A research equipment screen/UI wrapper recovers CHARACTER_EQUIPMENT_NETWORK_APPLY_FAILED only when details.network_result.success is true AND the already-installed local replica proves the item relation is the requested target container/slot. Server rejection, wrong container, wrong equipment slot, or unconfirmed replica state remain failures. The original presentation failure is preserved as presentation_warning. Third-person held-item presentation is intentionally deferred.
last_accepted_checkpoint: CH9.6 Playable Network Equipment Lab FOCUSED_ACCEPTED + POST_ACCEPTANCE_PC0_NON_RED @ e547ba52a440e72cc02c6bbe449edaf160bae7ab
next_stage: Operator updates the dedicated detached FPE worktree and reruns RUN_FPE_RESEARCH_TESTS.ps1. New required gates include FirstPerson hotbar presentation prediction PASS and FirstPerson equipment result policy PASS in addition to the existing core, network adapter, performance and graphical composition gates. Then PLAY_FPE_RESEARCH.ps1 must pass graphical composition preflight. Runtime acceptance for Fix7: pressing an occupied 1..0 slot changes the right-hand viewmodel immediately, pressing an empty slot clears it immediately, authority confirmation may remain delayed but must not delay presentation, repeated hotbar changes must not reintroduce movement hitch, and equipment drag must no longer show CHARACTER_EQUIPMENT_NETWORK_APPLY_FAILED when canonical replica state proves the operation succeeded. If an equipment server rejection occurs it must remain an error. Third-person held-item rendering is a later presentation follow-up. Missing Male_Peasant.gltf remains allowed for procedural sleeves. Do not rename this work CH9.7. Canonical world grabbing still requires a separate authority/network contract frontier.
